Overview

Bihać is a city in Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina with a population of 56,000. A city in northwestern Bosnia on the Una River, known for the stunning Una National Park waterfalls and its historic old town. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
